newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta call money stable at 7.0/8.0 percent.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta call money stable at 7.0/8.0 percent.

text.p: Jakarta call money was stable at 7.0/8.0 percent on Tuesday morning amid continued more than ample market liquidity, dealers said.
"Demand for the rupiah was slow despite weekly tax-payments," one local bank dealer said.
He added that the slow demand amid the flush liquidity had kept sentiment on the local currency weak.
Dealers said the central bank's injection of 1.738 trillion rupiah in early Tuesday after several days of relatively large injections, also helped keep sentiment weak.
One-week money was last quoted at 11.75/12.00, two at 12.25/12.50, while one and six-month money were last quoted at 13.25/13.50 and 14.75/15.00 respectively.
The average overnight interbank rate was at 9.73 percent on Monday compared with 10.40 on Friday.
